hero.title: Stop Juggling Tasks. Start Shipping.
hero.description: NudgeBoard is the Kanban-first task tracker for solo developers and small teams who just want to get things done.

heading.title: Everything You Need, Nothing You Don't
heading.subtitle: All the tools your team needs to stay organized, track progress, and deliver faster.

boards.title: Visual task management that just works
boards.description: Drag-and-drop Kanban with customizable columns, labels, and priorities. See your whole project at a glance.

tracking.title: Know exactly where your time goes
tracking.description: Built-in time tracking per task. Start a timer, log hours manually, and export reports without leaving the board.

offline.title: Works anywhere, even without internet
offline.description: Install as a PWA and keep working offline. Changes sync automatically when you reconnect.

heading.title: Get from zero to shipped in three steps
heading.subtitle: No complex setup. No steep learning curve. Just a clear path from idea to done.

create.title: Create a board
create.description: Set up your project board in seconds. Name it, pick a color, and you're ready to go.

add.title: Add tasks
add.description: Create cards, assign priorities, set due dates, and drag them across columns as work progresses.

track.title: Track & ship
track.description: Use built-in time tracking and progress views to stay on schedule. Ship with confidence.

heading.title: Built with tools you already know
heading.subtitle: A modern, production-ready stack — no bloat, no surprises.

finalCta.title: Ready to take control of your tasks?
finalCta.subtitle: Join developers and teams who replaced chaos with clarity.
finalCta.caption: No credit card required · Cancel anytime
